failure.apiKeyMissing: There is no OpenAI API key. Add one in Settings.
failure.connectionLost: The connection dropped before the reply finished. It may still have been made and billed.
failure.contentFiltered: OpenAI's content filter stopped this reply.
failure.diskFull: The disk is full, so the reply could not be saved.
failure.downloadFailed: The download did not finish. Check the connection and try again.
failure.exportFailed: The image could not be exported.
failure.fileMissing: An image this message needs is missing.
failure.filePermission: GptImg is not allowed to read or write a file this message needs.
failure.imageTooLarge: An attached image is too large to send.
failure.imageUnreadable: An attached image could not be read.
failure.invalidRequest: This request could not be made as it stands.
failure.invalidResponse: OpenAI's reply could not be read.
failure.keyRejected: OpenAI did not accept the API key. Check it in Settings.
failure.keyWrite: The API key could not be saved.
failure.memory: The computer ran out of memory for this image.
failure.moderationBlocked: OpenAI declined to make this image.
failure.needsFill: This image has transparent areas. Choose a fill colour to save it in this format.
failure.noSessionsFolder: Choose a folder for chats in Settings first.
failure.nothingToRetry: There is no unanswered message to try again.
failure.quotaExhausted: Your OpenAI account has no credit left.

failure.settingsWrite: Settings could not be saved. Your changes are still shown; try again.
failure.taskRunning: Another export or download is still running.

failure.trashOther: The chat could not be moved to the Recycle Bin.
failure.turnRunning: A reply is still on its way in this chat.
failure.unavailable: This could not be done right now.
failure.unreachable: OpenAI could not be reached. Check the connection.
failure.upscaleFailed: The image could not be upscaled.
failure.upscalerMissing: The upscaling model is not downloaded yet.
failure.workerLost: The image engine stopped while working. The reply may still have been made and billed.

settings.chatModelHelp: Reads the conversation, answers and decides when to make or change an image.
settings.contentFontHelp: Used for messages and replies, as a CSS font list.
settings.draftsHelp: Shows rough versions of an image while it is drawn. Each draft adds a little to the cost.
settings.endpointHelp: Where requests go. Leave OpenAI's address unless you use a proxy or another service that speaks OpenAI's API.
settings.error.choice: Choose one of the offered values.
settings.error.endpoint: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
settings.error.lineHeight: Use a line height from {min} to {max}.
settings.error.timeZone: This time zone is not known.
settings.imageModelHelp: Makes and edits the images the assistant asks for.
settings.keyFromEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY is set in the environment, so it is used instead of the saved key.
settings.keyHelp: Stored in its own file, readable only by you, not in settings. Type a new key to replace it.
settings.keyWillClear: The saved key will be cleared when you save.
settings.openaiOnly: GptImg uses OpenAI's models; requests are billed to this key's account.
settings.problem.invalidSets.one: One saved setting was not valid and its default is shown. Saving replaces it.
settings.problem.invalidSets.other: {count} saved settings were not valid and their defaults are shown. Saving replaces them.
settings.problem.locked: Settings cannot be saved while the settings file cannot be read: {path}
settings.problem.malformed: The settings file could not be understood, so defaults are in use and the file is left as it is: {path}
settings.problem.unreadable: The settings file could not be read, so defaults are in use and the file is left as it is: {path}
settings.sessionsHelp: Each chat is a folder here with its messages, images and attached files. Moving the folder later is safe; choose its new place here.
settings.thinkingHelp: How much the assistant reasons before answering. More is slower and uses more tokens.
settings.title: Settings
settings.unsupportedModel: This model is not supported and may not work as expected.
setup.folderBody: Each chat is saved as a folder here, with every message, image and attached file, so it can be reopened and continued at any time.
setup.intro: GptImg makes images with your own OpenAI account; each message is billed to it.
setup.keyFromEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY is set in the environment, so GptImg will use it. You can still store a key later in Settings.
setup.keyHelp: Create one at platform.openai.com. It is stored in GptImg's own folder, readable only by you.

shortcuts.moveSessions: Move through chats in the list
